notes.title: Forbidden Art - Patch note (v.1.3.0) Additional languages update

Hello 
This is AIXLAB.
We have some great news for those of you in Japan, Germany, and Russia who have been blocked by language barriers.

Other languages will be added in the future.

[/list]

notes.title: Forbidden Art - Patch note (v.1.2.7)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI would execute an attack even if the player was positioned behind a wall or obstacle.

[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the final puzzle.

[*] Added more items to the inventory.

[*] Optimized the system for loading levels.

[*] Made additional fixes for double-saving issues with some save points.
[/list]

notes.title: Forbidden Art - Patch note (v.1.2.6)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where previously passed savepoints would be double-saved when selecting "Continue".
(Players who have already saved before this latest version will still experience a double save, but gameplay will not be affected).

[*] Players could sometimes get stuck on a level and not be able to advance to the next level when selecting "Continue".
This was identified as a bug related to the double save mentioned above and has been fixed.

[*] Fixed an issue where opening a lid or drawer would grab the object inside before opening it.
[/list]

notes.title: Forbidden Art - Patch note (v.1.2.5)
notes.notes:
hello
This is AIXLAB, the developer of Forbidden Art.

We continue to experience intermittent issues with the level loading process. 
In previous patches, we were able to fix it by working within the existing system.
However, the same bug continued to occur, so in this patch, we've completely gutted the system and developed a new one.

If you're still experiencing bugs with level loading after version 1.2.5, please let us know through the community.
It will help us improve the game. 
Screenshots or videos of the bug would be especially appreciated.

As always, we're grateful to everyone who plays Forbidden Art.
We apologize to anyone who has experienced bugs with level loading.

notes.notes:

This has been fixed.

[*]The Zippo lighter is an important object in Forbidden Art. 
You'll often need to pull it out often, so we've added a hotkey to allow you to do so without going through your inventory. (thanks Getter)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/400a98d57de80a6bab880cc338bd53659b1d0544.gif[/img]

notes.title: Forbidden Art: March 25th 2024 Full release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/6cfcd04a2a8f99e817f9a7b6e0057117001a8a36.png[/img]

Hello! 
This is AIXLAB, developers of Forbidden Art.
After almost 4 months of early access, we are finally releasing the full game on Monday, March 25, 2024 at 00:00(PST)!
We've summarized and incorporated feedback from players during the Early Access period. 
We've also prioritized usability updates to make it easier for players to immerse themselves in the game.



[h2]NEW PUZZLES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/60e97a9dff99ff777606a46084df3c77dbbdefe5.png[/img]

In response to feedback that there weren't enough puzzles, we've added a few more puzzles per zone. Players who previously completed the game on Early Access are welcome to try the new puzzles again!



[h2]ENVIRNONMENT UPDATES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/7cf5b99df1928789a56ba706bcfcdbd85665ac0c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/30e314ff515658116257d366de0196f76359b9e8.png[/img]

Brightened the lighting a bit in areas where it was not necessary to use a light source for the game's design intent. 
Added some background elements.
Added a killer's animation.



[h2]ADDED WRITABLE DIARY[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/199d0303267531db2fad30333081a746da0c0185.gif[/img]

While it is possible to solve all puzzles without taking notes, we have added note-taking to speed up some sections and for overall player enjoyment and convenience.



[h2]OTHER FIXED AND ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed footstep sounds to sound more natural.
[*] Fixed an issue where players in 'crouch' mode would have to drop lower than shown when passing through height restricted areas.
[*] 'Quick turn' could sometimes cause objects to collide and trigger the sound detector, causing the player to game over. 'Quick turn' no longer cause object collision sounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could grab important items in their inventory through walls.
[*] Fixed the sound detector in the office reacting to the sound of the gramophone in the office (this shouldn't cause a game over, but was causing some players to question it).
[*] Changed the save system in J's room to fix an issue that caused certain puzzles to be repeated over and over again.
[*] Fixed candles placed on maps to better catch fire.
[*] Changed options such as Quick turn and sound settings to persist when the game is turned off and on.
[/list]


We hope to provide you with the best quality possible when you play Forbidden Art.
Feedbacks on the game are always welcome.
Thank you!

Hello, this is AIXLAB.

Fixed some inventory items being grabbed through walls and doors.

We have a surprise for you next week! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix : Localization issue Fix
notes.notes:
Some tutorials were not localized.
We've made some localization fixes.

Added control guide images to the rotation and height adjustment options.

notes.title: Hotfix: Added UI for the back of the lobby
notes.notes:
There was an issue in the lobby where if you were facing backwards relative to the front and the game was launched, you would only see a black screen, which could be a bit confusing for players.
We've added a UI to the back of the lobby to improve this.
We also fixed an issue where players were previously able to move behind the lobby board.

notes.notes:
Forbidden Art is updated to version 0.02.1.

Fixed dial-type locks to be able to rotate in reverse.
Fixed an issue with ringed keys moving unnaturally.
Fixed an issue where the killer would not attack the player when playing in Crouch mode.
Fixed an issue where the killer animation would not work correctly in certain sections when playing in Crouch mode.
Fixed an issue where "Quick turn" would not work correctly on some HMDs.
Fixed a shader issue with indicator particles in 6x6 mode.
Fixed animations running one more time in some puzzles.

notes.title: Hotfix : > Download and launch issues for Chinese users
notes.notes:
Hello, this is AIXLAB Games.

We have recently addressed the download and launch issues experienced by players in China.
We have now successfully resolved this issue, and all players can now download and launch << Forbidden Art >> smoothly.

Here's how to fix it

Update your Steam client to the latest version.
Delete the << Forbidden Art >> game file, then download it again via Steam.
After the installation is complete, try running the game.
If you encounter any issues during this process, please contact us via the Steam Community Forums.
Our team is ready to respond to your queries quickly.

Thank you very much for your patience and support.
We now look forward to you enjoying the thrilling experience of << Forbidden Art >>.
We hope your gameplay is smooth, and we will continue to strive to provide you with the best gaming experience.

Happy gaming!

AIXLAB Games

notes.title: 🎮✨Forbidden Art 0.02.0 version released🚀🎨
notes.notes:
Hi happy holidays! 
Forbidden Art is updated to version 0.02.0.

1. Fixed an issue where the playtime was not displayed correctly in the game completion result window.⏱️ 
2. Changed the turntable in the office level to be player-operated.🎛️
3. Modified and changed the tutorial for convenience.📚
4. Fixed corpse hit sound being duplicated.🔊
5. Fixed an issue with the sound detector working over walls when a sound occurs.🚧
6. Footsteps now play with the corresponding flooring material.👣
7. Added the option to swap between QuickTurn and SmoothTurn.⚙️
8. Added height adjustments like crouching and standing.📏
9. Fixed an issue where it was sometimes impossible to interact with objects when entering vent. 🛠️ (Thanks FairlighT21🙏)

Thanks!
